data.field_of_study: biomedical sciences, chemistry, physics, engineering and related STEM fields
data.other_hard: international students must have completed or be on track to obtain a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a Singapore Autonomous University; obtained or on track to obtain at least Second-Class (Upper) Honours or equivalent in a relevant discipline; in the last semester of final studies to apply; satisfy the criteria for and gain admission to a PhD programme in an autonomous university; endorsement from proposed A*STAR supervisor; research conducted in whole or part at an A*STAR Research Institute
data.evidence_sentence: Open to applicants of all nationalities.
data.notes: Page also describes a Mid-Term AGS track with extra criteria (enrolled and completed at least 1 semester, on track for excellent academic standing, good research potential, current supervisor as academic referee); these are not applied here as the award is the general AGS. Application windows are given without years, so annual dates are used. Service commitment for non-SPR foreigners (3 years in Singapore-based companies) is a post-award condition, not an entry requirement. Page says criteria are not exhaustive and A*STAR may add selection criteria. Specialised tracks (Semiconductor, Quantum, Computing) receive a higher stipend. Bond-free for Singapore citizens and SPRs.
